clips.title: Who Did You Come to See Today?

lines.ja: ではやってまいりました！
lines.speaker: Interviewer

lines.ja: 今日は誰を見に来たんですか？
lines.en: Who did you guys come to see today?
lines.speaker: Interviewer

lines.ja: おお！全員違う！みんなバラバラ！
lines.en: Oh, all different! Everyone's got their own!
lines.speaker: Interviewer

lines.ja: 服がイケイケです、すごい。
lines.en: Your outfits are super cool, amazing.
lines.speaker: Interviewer

lines.ja: 今のは冗談で、えー、好きな食べ物は？
lines.en: That was a joke, but what's your favorite food?
lines.speaker: Interviewer

lines.ja: 好きな食べ物は寿司が好きっすね。
lines.en: As for favorite food, I like sushi.
lines.speaker: Passerby

lines.ja: あ、お寿司が好き。ま、もちろん何ですかね？
lines.en: Ah, sushi! And naturally, which one?
lines.speaker: Interviewer

lines.ja: マグロと言ってもなんか2、3個ぐらい種類ある…
lines.en: Even with tuna, there are a few kinds...
lines.speaker: Interviewer

lines.ja: ああ、まあマグロんなかでも卵が一番好きっす。
lines.en: Well, among tuna, egg is my absolute favorite.
lines.speaker: Passerby
